# OnNetworkMessage

[API index](../index.md)

```typescript
function OnNetworkMessage(channel?: string | null): NetworkMessageRuleBuilderContext;
```

Register a channel-specific message rule; `.If(...)` and `.Do(...)` receive the message.
Rules are dispatched while automation is active.

**Parameter `channel`**

Channel name; omitted or whitespace-only values select "default", not all channels.

**Example**

```ts
OnNetworkMessage("party").Do(message => Log(message.Content));
```

**@keywords**

network, message, channel, subscribe
